notes: v1.0.13 reduce Gemini timeout to 180s, V3 pacing, validation repair, headless pipeline
New: Reduce Gemini response timeout from 900s to 180s
New: V3 DynamicPacingBlock with FAST/MEDIUM/COMPACT profiles and mathematical segment count formula
New: Validation repair turn (max 2 attempts, same conversation) for TIMELINE_FULL_TEXT_MISMATCH, TIMELINE_DURATION_INCOMPLETE

Change: End users see only generic messages for internal Gemini/validation errors
Change: Saved Gemini auth session is preserved across updates
